gaps.sentence: My grandfather was ___ engineer during the war.
gaps.explanation: 'An engineer' — 'engineer' begins with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: The train arrived ___ hour late because of signal failure.
gaps.explanation: 'Hour' begins with a silent h, so the vowel form 'an' is required.
'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
What ___ pity that the show closed so soon.
gaps.explanation: 'What a pity' is the fixed exclamatory phrase.

gaps.sentence: He was sent to ___ prison for armed robbery.
gaps.explanation: 'Be sent to prison' (as a prisoner) takes no article; visiting the building is 'go to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: His mother went to ___ prison to visit him.
gaps.explanation: Visitors go to the building: 'went to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
